quest.title: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
quest.description: Deep amidst the permafrost's howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye... Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Gate blocked by ice and snow
dialogues.text: (You can feel the chill even as you draw close... In this environment, ice and snow of such thickness simply will not melt.)

dialogues.speaker: Gate blocked by ice and snow
dialogues.text: (The faint sound of music seems closer now...)

talks.objective: Approach the massive figure in the snowstorm$HIDDEN

dialogues.speaker: Gate blocked by ice and snow
dialogues.text: (The door is sealed by frozen snow... It doesn't budge an inch.)

dialogues.speaker: Gate blocked by ice and snow
dialogues.text: (But... you do hear a faint sound coming from behind that door.)

talks.objective: Investigate the chains binding the giant
Wait for the storm to disappear

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Where could he have gone? And what about that girl's shadow? Paimon wonders how she's even connected to a giant guy like him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...But honestly, Paimon has a feeling we're going to run into him somewhere else.
